'''''Convolvulus farinosus''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Convolvulaceae]]. It is native to [[sub-Saharan Africa]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Convolvulus farinosus L. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science|url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:266193-1|access-date=2021-03-04|website=Plants of the World Online|language=en}}</ref>
